expected.menuSignatureNote: CLEARED 2026-08-18, awaiting regeneration on a machine with a Swift toolchain. maintenanceSlotBudgetsAreFeasible changed its distinct-movement cap from maintenanceCeiling/2 to (maintenanceCeiling + dose - 1)/dose with dose=3, so a recovery-tight ceiling of 8 admits 3 movements instead of 4 and Triceps and Back/Lats no longer sit at 2 sets across 4 movements. That necessarily moves this snapshot, and the author had no compiler to recompute it. REGENERATE: TRANSFORM_FIXTURE_SNAPSHOT_OUTPUT=/tmp/menu.txt swift test --enable-xctest --filter testFiveMaintenanceErrorFixtureStaysResolved ; then paste /tmp/menu.txt's lines into menuSignature and delete this note and menuSignaturePriorValue. ALSO CHECK: expected.validatorIssues is pinned to [] and was NOT verified after this change. Freed maintenance slots are refilled from the catalog, so if a day now lands under five exercises the validator emits 'Day N must have 5-8 exercises.' and this fixture will fail on that assertion too, not only on the snapshot. The last-resort sweeps relax the cap to dose=2 (reproducing the old numbers exactly) specifically to prevent that, but it is unverified here. GeneratorTroubleshootingTests skips only the snapshot assertion while menuSignature is empty; its day-count, validator-verdict, ledger-consistency, variation-policy and forbidden-fragment assertions all still run. MaintenanceDoseFragmentationTests guards the property this change was made for.
